title: Massachusetts Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & Filing
rank_math_description: Massachusetts small claims in 2026: $7,000 limit (no cap for car damage), $40-$150 fees, mailed notice, one-way appeals, payment orders and 93A letters.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter (93A: 30 days before) -> choose district (yours or defendant's) -> Statement of Small Claim -> fee ($40-$150) -> clerk mails notice -> mediation -> hearing (clerk-magistrate) -> defendant's 10-day appeal -> payment order / payment review hearing / trustee process
featured_image_prompt: Massachusetts district courthouse with New England brick and white trim in autumn, a folder of receipts on a bench in the foreground, navy and crimson accents, editorial photo style, no text

inline_images.prompt: icon flow: claim, mailed notice, mediation or hearing, 10-day defendant appeal, payment order, navy/crimson on cream

editor_notes: mass.gov blocks automated access from the cloud; fees taken from 'Small Claims Standards 3:03 Filing fees' via search. The 12% interest statement is general (G.L. c. 231 §§6B-6C / c. 235 §8); if you want a firmer cite, check mass.gov's judgment interest page when publishing.
